launcher.load: Load a layout (add to current windows)
launcher.merge: Load a layout (merge with current windows)
launcher.mergeDesc: Reuse matching windows, close the unneeded ones
launcher.save: Save current windows as a layout

settings.confirmCleanDesc: Ask for confirmation before closing every window.
settings.confirmDeleteDesc: Require a second click to delete a layout.
settings.showToastsDesc: Show a toast on save / load / delete.
settings.closePanelOnActionDesc: Automatically close the panel after loading, saving, renaming or deleting a layout.
settings.defaultLoadModeDesc: Mode used by the primary load button: add to the current windows, replace everything, or merge (reuse matching windows and close the unneeded ones).
settings.springLoadDelayDesc: Delay before switching workspace when dragging a window over a tab in the editor
settings.colorizeAppIconsDesc: Tint application icons (in the layout list and the editor) with a palette color.
settings.appIconColorDesc: Palette color used to tint application icons.
settings.overridesDesc: Override the launch command per window class. Fixes apps that are skipped when loading because their real command can't be relaunched.
